conversations.question: Why can't I save a draft of a new listing, when the Save draft and Submit listing buttons are both gray?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie gave no answer. It restated the problem and offered a live agent twice, then asked for more details. A teammate later explained that Save draft only works once every field through County is filled in, and that the city and county the member needed were missing from the MLS lists.

conversations.question: Can a live agent contact me to set up a Zoom training call?
conversations.perchie_answer: The member asked for a live agent right away, and Perchie connected them without trying to answer. The teammate then explained that Baldwin MLS staff run training and shared the Baldwin training calendar.
conversations.source_title: How to Complete Required Perchwell Training

conversations.question: I can add more than one virtual tour to a listing, but only one shows publicly; is that correct?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie did not answer. It restated the question and offered a live agent, which the member accepted. The member then worked it out on their own.

conversations.question: How do I take my listing off the market permanently when I don't see that option under Property status?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie told the member to choose Withdrawn instead of Temp off mkt. The member replied that Withdrawn is not in the list either, and a teammate told them to use Temp Off Market for now while the team checks.

conversations.question: How do I run a CMA for one condo unit when four towers share two street addresses and the unit number is what tells them apart?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said there is no unit number field in the CMA and suggested turning on Include exact address. It never covered how to pick the right unit as the subject property.
conversations.cause: Article unclear or missing the member's words
conversations.source_title: Create a CMA with a Subject Property

conversations.question: How do I re-enter an expired listing?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said to go to Manage Listings, select the expired listing, and click Duplicate. It added that the copy is saved as a draft to review and submit, and that Days on Market starts at 0.

conversations.question: How do I find waterfront properties?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said to open Filters, type water in Search filters and values, and set Lot Description, Water Property Type, Named Waterfront Y/N, or Waterfront Footage. It also mentioned that filters use OR by default.

conversations.question: A client says they tagged 25 listings they like for me, so where do I see those listings?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie first sent the member to the Liked filter in Shared properties in Messages. After the member said nothing was there, it pointed to the contact's Shared Listings and the Liked column on the Tags page, said clients cannot add listings to a Tag, and asked how the client shared them.
conversations.cause: Article unclear or missing the member's words

conversations.question: Why don't bedroom count and property type show up when I search for them on the Filters tab?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie explained that Property Type and Beds are Quick Filters at the top of the Search page and do not appear in the Search filters and values search. It said everything else is found by typing the filter name on the Filters tab.

conversations.question: Is there a printed or digital how-to guide for basic tasks like searches and CMAs?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie misread the request as how to print search results and CMA reports as PDFs, and gave those steps. When the member asked how to download the guides, it repeated the report-printing steps.

conversations.question: Can an agent clone a listing that closed within the last 12 months?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said to duplicate it from Manage Listings, then to filter Manage Listings to Closed. The member said the listing had never been in their Manage Listings and was told it was locked, so the conversation went to a teammate.
conversations.cause: Article unclear or missing the member's words

conversations.question: Can I let an AI assistant like ChatGPT into my Perchwell account to manage saved searches, without sharing my password?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said no: Perchwell has no API or approved integration for outside assistants, and Assume Identity is the only approved way for someone else to access the account.

conversations.question: How does an agent add photos to a draft listing?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said to open the draft from Manage Listings with the pencil icon, click Upload or drop photos in the Media section, and save the draft, with JPG or PNG files up to 15 MB each.

conversations.question: How does an agent add a Matterport tour made by another company to their listing?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said to paste the Matterport link into a virtual tour field at the end of Property Details and submit updates. The member confirmed this solved it.

conversations.question: Why can't I create One Page Reports, which fail with an error that the PDF could not be exported?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said the browser was probably blocking the export and suggested allowing pop-ups and clearing the cache. The real cause was a site-wide release, which a teammate confirmed.

conversations.question: In a staff test of Perchie: why do search results drop to zero when Price increase or Price drop is selected on a search for one condo development?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie gave no answer. It restated the problem, offered a live agent, and asked for more details about the search setup.
conversations.cause: Article unclear or missing the member's words
conversations.source_title: Filter Your Search by Status and Price Changes

conversations.question: How do I change my listing from Active under contract to Pending?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said to go to Manage Listings, click the pencil icon, change the Status to Pending, and save, and explained what Pending means.

conversations.question: Is there a search filter for listings with an assumable mortgage?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said there is no assumable mortgage filter and suggested a keyword search for assumable. The Financing filter has an Assumable value.

conversations.question: How do I add a new search to a contact I already have?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie gave the steps to attach a contact to a search that is already saved, but left out building and saving the new search first.
conversations.cause: Article unclear or missing the member's words
conversations.source_title: Share a Saved Search with a Client

conversations.question: Where do I find the Baldwin County forms?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie pointed the agent to the Integrations panel on the Dashboard, then asked whether they meant the association's forms library or forms attached to a listing.

fixes.change: Add "Can I search for listings with an assumable mortgage?": yes, enter Financing in Search filters and values on the Filters tab and select Assumable. Confirmed by Jeff. (The optional Quick Filters question was dropped: Perchie answered it correctly.)

Add "Find a Perchwell how-to guide, manual, or PDF": there is no printed manual; the help center is the guide, any article prints or saves as a PDF, with links to starter articles, the Video Library, and Quick Start training. Moved here from Common Perchwell FAQs, which is an Intercom draft Perchie cannot read.

Add "Fix a gray Save draft button" (fill in every field through County; ask MLS staff to add a missing city or county, and save with any available one meanwhile) and "Change a listing's status, such as Active under contract to Pending". The status field name and required fields still need a check in the product.

fixes.target: Listing Maintenance FAQ, duplicate a listing
fixes.change: Add a first step to "How do I duplicate or clone a listing?": select Expired or Closed under Status in Filters, because those listings are hidden by default. Say you can duplicate only listings in your own Manage Listings, and add the words relist, re-enter, and put an expired listing back on the market.

fixes.target: Listing Maintenance FAQ and What Each Listing Status Means
fixes.change: Add "How do I take my listing off the market?" listing the off-market statuses an agent can select, and whether Withdrawn or Canceled must be requested from Baldwin MLS staff. Needs the rule confirmed first: the member could not see Withdrawn, and the team was still checking.

Under the video and Matterport tour question, say which of Virtual tour #1, Virtual tour #2, and Branded virtual tour shows on the public listing and which only in the MLS. Needs product to confirm the behavior first.

Add "My client says they liked or tagged listings for me. Where do I see them?": the Liked column on the Tags page, the Like filter in Shared properties in Messages, and listings a client sent with Share Listings with Your Agent. Say clients cannot create Tags or add listings to one.

fixes.target: Share a Saved Search with a Client
fixes.change: Add "Add a new search to an existing contact": click Start New, set filters, click Save, name the search, then open the pencil icon and pick the contact. Use the words add a search to a contact and set up a search for a client.

fixes.target: Filter Your Search by Status and Price Changes
fixes.change: In the price drop section, add: if results go to zero when you select Price drop or Price increase, no listing in your search changed price in the last 30 days; set a longer window such as 180 or 365 days.

fixes.target: Create a CMA with a Subject Property
fixes.change: Add a short section on a condo unit in a building with several towers: open the exact unit by MLS ID or by address with the unit, or add the subject property by hand and narrow comps with Subdivision/Condo. Low confidence; check in the product before drafting.

Add "Can ChatGPT or another AI assistant log in to my account or manage my saved searches?" with the product-approved answer. Perchie said no API exists, which no article backs, and pointed to Assume Identity, which is not meant for this.

When a member quotes an error message from Perchwell, such as "could not export that PDF", give at most one quick step, then offer to connect them with the support team instead of a list of browser fixes.

When a Baldwin member asks for training or a training call, say that Baldwin MLS staff run Perchwell training, share the registration page from How to Complete Required Perchwell Training, and hand off only if the member still wants a person.

When a member asks for Baldwin County or Baldwin REALTORS forms or contracts, say Perchwell does not host association forms, do not send them to the Integrations panel, and give the Baldwin MLS staff contact or hand off. Once MLS staff confirm where the forms live, add that to the MLS Rules and Compliance FAQ.

conversations.question: How do I search by the selling agent on past deals?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said to use the Agent filter on the Filters tab, enter the agent's name, and choose Buy-side for the selling side.

conversations.question: Why does the form not return to the main screen after I select the selling agent when changing a listing to Active under contract?
conversations.perchie_answer: Acknowledged the problem and offered a live agent, then handed off when the agent said yes because of a deadline fee. This was a bug report, so handing off was right.

conversations.question: My edited listing is not showing as sold and I do not have permission to get back into it.
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie acknowledged the issue and offered to connect the member with a live agent, which the member accepted. This was a bug report, so handing off was right.

conversations.question: I am trying to mark a listing Pending, it says 4 of 84 required fields are missing, and the View incomplete fields link is not working.
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie apologized and offered to connect the agent to a live agent, which the agent accepted.

conversations.question: How do I create a saved search?
conversations.perchie_answer: First explained how to open saved searches and turn on alerts, then gave the steps to set filters on the Search page, click Save, and name the search.

conversations.question: How do I duplicate a listing that is already expired?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said to select the listing on Manage Listings and click Duplicate at the bottom, which creates a draft, and noted Days on Market starts at zero when an expired listing is relisted this way.

conversations.question: How can I get a QR code for a listing that is large enough to put on a sign?
conversations.perchie_answer: Pointed the agent to the One Page Report and Show Sheet QR codes, then said the QR code size is fixed by the report template and cannot be enlarged.

conversations.question: How do I change a listing from Active to Pending, and what about Active Under Contract?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said to open the listing from Manage Listings with the pencil icon, set the Status field to Pending and save, and cited a 3-business-day rule; it then correctly explained Active Under Contract versus Pending.

conversations.question: How do I attach the search I just created to a contact?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie said to open Saved Searches, click the pencil icon on the search, check the contact in the Contacts dropdown, and click Update.

conversations.question: Where do I find the video on a listing?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie pointed to a 'Photos and Multimedia' section on the Listing Detail Page and said videos come from the Virtual Tour fields; on follow-up it said the listing may have no video and suggested the photo gallery grid icon.
conversations.cause: Article unclear or missing the member's words

conversations.question: How do I find my login information, and how do I find my Baldwin Realtors portal login?
conversations.perchie_answer: Perchie explained that Perchwell uses the Baldwin portal username and password and to open Perchwell from Quick Links; on the follow-up it repeated the same answer without saying how to recover a forgotten portal username or password.
conversations.cause: Article unclear or missing the member's words

conversations.question: How do I report a listing that has false information?
conversations.perchie_answer: Directed the agent to CRS Listing Integrity under Agent Tools on the listing page or the Report a Listing integration, and gave the MLS staff contact.

conversations.question: How do I change my saved search alerts from immediate to daily?
conversations.perchie_answer: Gave steps to open the saved search, choose Daily in the Frequency dropdown, optionally pick Morning or Evening, and click Update.
conversations.source_title: Set Up Email Alerts for Saved Searches

fixes.change: Add "Request a missing subdivision": members cannot add one themselves; Baldwin MLS staff send the request to Perchwell, which adds it, usually within days. Add "Find the missing required fields": the orange number next to each section name and the orange bar on each required field show what is left, for when the View incomplete fields link does nothing. Draft together with F3 on the same article.

Add "A draft I did not make is on my Manage Listings page": it most likely came from someone duplicating one of your listings; open it with the pencil icon and click Delete to remove it. Use the words unknown draft and old listing.

fixes.target: Create a CMA with a Subject Property
fixes.change: Add "My subject property is not in Perchwell": off-market and public-record properties are not pulled in, so add the subject property by hand and build the CMA from comps. Needs the options confirmed in the product; draft together with last week's F10 on the same article.

fixes.target: Filter Your Search by Property Type and Subtype
fixes.change: Add "Why do rentals show up in my for-sale search?": status filters such as Active and Coming Soon include rentals, so select the sale property types in the Property Type quick filter in the upper left. Name attached and detached, since members search with those words.

Add "What does Awaiting Approval mean?": some brokerages require a broker admin to approve a listing before it goes live; the agent cannot edit it while it waits, and the broker admin approves it or sends it back to Draft.

fixes.target: Add and Edit Listings in the Perchwell Mobile App
fixes.change: Add "Why don't I see my draft in the app?": tap My Listings, open Filters, clear the other filters, select Drafts under Publication Status, and select every listing status.
Add "I forgot my Baldwin REALTORS portal username or password": use the portal's password reset link, or contact Baldwin MLS staff. Draft together with F11 on the same article.

Say exactly where a listing's video or virtual tour opens on the Listing Detail Page, and use the word video next to virtual tour. Which tour fields show there depends on last week's F6, so confirm both together.

fixes.target: Answer first, then offer a teammate
fixes.change: When a help center article answers the question, give that answer before offering a live agent, even when the member sounds stuck or frustrated. Two chats this week got only a handoff offer when an article had the answer (an unexpected draft, rentals in a for-sale search).
